title: What working with AI feels like
author: Hungry-Fig-8640
selftext: Not sure why but this frequently pops into my head when working with AI nowadays after being a naysayer initially, Just thought it was funny and wanted to share

comments.author: geldonyetich
comments.body: A little bit, at least the tangent that technology changed the picture, and the old jobs changed with it. But AI isn't Walmart. It's an inevitability of having this much compute laying around.

replies.author: Hungry-Fig-8640
replies.body: Very true, there really isn't a equivalent I can think of for the scale of the AI revolution. I was extremely pessimistic until i tried a paid model (opus) recently at a friend's behest. The performance gap is immense, it's now like software steroids. The Hallucinations are fewer and less detrimental than when i tried previously.

replies.author: geldonyetich
replies.body: Yeah I have been doing surprisingly well running Qwen and Ornith locally too. Granted my game is somewhat in the vein of a classic roguelike so it doesn't need a huge scope capability. But it's still about as good as the effort I put into it.
